proposals.evidence: DEDR 1443 full article (p. 134) lists Kota kaṇ-/kāṇ- “to see, with kaḍ- stem and vow/divination extensions”. Wolf kaṇ- “to consult god through tērkārn about some matter (ān devr kaṇkve)” matches this specific form-and-sense family; the complete article is retained in primary evidence. The source wording and morphology are preserved. Wolf also records conjugational stem kaḍ-, matching the DEDR Kota kaṇ-/kāṇ- (kaḍ-) paradigm; the article includes kaṇky, a payment of a vow to a god.
